description: This file implements Huffman encoding and decoding functions for HTTP/2 header compression in the 'hpack' package, including Huffman decoding, encoding length calculation, and Huffman string appending.

methods.name: HuffmanDecode
methods.description: Decodes a Huffman-encoded byte slice into an io.Writer, returning the number of bytes written and an error if decoding fails.

methods.name: HuffmanDecodeToString
methods.description: Decodes a Huffman-encoded byte slice into a string, returning the decoded string and an error if decoding fails.

methods.name: huffmanDecode
methods.description: Internal function that decodes Huffman-encoded data into a buffer, used by public decode functions.

methods.name: AppendHuffmanString
methods.description: Encodes a string into Huffman codes and appends it to a byte slice, returning the extended slice.

methods.name: HuffmanEncodeLength
methods.description: Calculates the number of bytes needed to Huffman-encode a string, rounded up to the nearest byte boundary.
